title: gator-session-snippet-v2
description: Per-commit session snippet emitted to .gator/session-snippets/*.json by the base Gator post-commit path (record_commit_and_emit_snippet in precommit_session.py). Consumed by the Enterprise session-block pipeline and by the Dashboard audit view. This is shared Desktop infrastructure — not gated behind Enterprise configuration. Schema is additive: new optional fields may appear in future emissions without a version bump; removing or changing a required field IS a version bump.

schema.description: Schema version discriminator. Bump the trailing digit for breaking changes.

architect.description: Human operator identity (from Gator-Architect trailer, formerly Gator-PI).

agent.description: AI agent identifier (vendor,model or canonical vendor name).

intent.description: One-line intent statement from commit_draft.md message field.

change_type.description: Semantic change type from Gator's own vocabulary (not Conventional Commits). Empty string permitted. Adding a new value requires updating this enum in the same commit.

significance.description: Significance tier from commit_draft frontmatter. Empty string permitted. `architectural` added 2026-08-10 (v2.6.0) to formalize a value that had been in de facto use for cross-module invariant changes.

charter_changed.description: Whether a charter was updated. Boolean canonical; string values ("yes"/"no"/"override-skip"/"") accepted for legacy trailer values and explicit-override sentinels.

snippet_id.description: Snippet identifier: literal 'snippet-' followed by first 13 chars of commit hash.

session_group_key.description: Session grouping key: '{vendor}:{transcript_session_id}'. Null when no active vendor session detected.

branch.description: Git branch at time of commit.

commit_index.description: 1-indexed position of this commit within its session group.

previous_commit_in_session.description: Full SHA of the previous commit in the same session group, or null if first.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the session group began.

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this commit.

vendor_inferred.description: Vendor (anthropic, openai, google, cursor, ...) inferred from the active session or trailer. Null when unknown.

model_inferred.description: Model identifier (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-6[1m]'). Bracketed suffix flags context-window mode.

files_touched.description: Repo-relative paths modified in this commit.

notes.description: Session Change Log bullets from commit_draft.md body.

transcript_session_id.description: Vendor-native session identifier (Claude Code session UUID, Codex conversation ID, etc.). Null when no active vendor session detected.

transcript_ref.description: Never populated in committed snippets. Local transcript paths are not committed to git. Field reserved for post-commit enrichment layers.

session_id.description: Optional alias emitted by some code paths for transcript_session_id. New consumers should prefer transcript_session_id.

files_touched_source.description: Optional provenance tag naming which upstream source populated files_touched.
